blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Families of two men killed in an armed encounter between government troops and suspected New People’s Army (NPA) members arrived in Esperanza, Agusan del Sur, on Monday to claim their remains. Elvira Lamanilao, former staff of Mayor Deo Manpatilan Jr., who is now a board member of the Agusan del Sur Electric Cooperative Inc., announced the development in a social media post on Tuesday. The relatives of the two men, identified only by their aliases “Doydoy” and “Kikoy,” came from Claveria and Gingoog City and met with Manpatilan, municipal police chief Lt.
